dance.guide: Dance minigame. Input button: {0}. One short stick click sounds one beat before each ordinary note. Wait one beat, then press once; at 146 BPM a beat is about 411 milliseconds. Do not press immediately or wait to copy a teacher demonstration. Three short stick clicks mean the rapid-tapping section has started. Immediately press the same button repeatedly as fast as possible. This does not mean only three presses, and you should not match the speed of the three clicks. The clicks are spaced in eighth notes. Answer the tutorial question using the spoken yes/no choices. F3 repeats dialogue or choices. Help does not pause the game.

farming.guide: PATAPON 2 vegetable farming. Action key: {0}. Each visible note has a short stick cue one beat early. Wait one beat, then press once. Later notes are not always on every beat; follow each cue. Falling tones announce rests: one for one beat, two for two beats, three for three beats. Start resting on the beat after the first falling tone. The next stick cue is also one beat early; wait one beat before resuming. The catching phase keeps its existing cue. F1 offers sound previews and volume adjustment. Cues do not pause the game or press buttons.
